title: 中断电缆安装任务后教程卡住，无法继续
description: 中断电缆安装任务后教程卡住，无法继续
evidence: I also completely broke the tutorial by just interrupting the install task of a cable to get more air. There's no way to continue installing it, and I cannot continue the tutorial or open the unpowered door, because the cable installation job DOES NOT WANT TO CONTINUE.
